public class rotate_array {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
int[]arr= {-1,-100,3,99};
int k=2;
int s=0;
int end=arr.length;
int j=end-k;
reverse(arr,s,j-1);
reverse(arr,j,end-1);
reverse(arr,s,end-1);
for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++) {
	System.out.println(arr[i]);
}
	}
	public static void reverse(int[] arr,int s,int end) {
		while(s<=end) {
			swap(arr,s,end);
			s++;
			end--;
		}
	}
	public static void swap(int[] arr,int i,int j) {
		int c=arr[i];
		arr[i]=arr[j];
		arr[j]=c;
	}

}

public static void swap(int[] arr,int i,int j) {
	int k=arr[i];
	arr[i]=arr[j];
	arr[j]=k;
}

for(int i=0;i<arr.length-1;i++) {
	if(arr[i]+1!=arr[i+1]) {
		System.out.println(arr[i]+1);
	}
}

System.out.println("0");

class Solution {
    public int singleNumber(int[] nums) {
          Arrays.sort(nums); // Ensure the array is sorted
        int left = 0;
        int right = nums.length - 1;

        while (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;

            // Check the pair alignment
            if (mid % 2 == 0) {
                if (nums[mid] == nums[mid + 1]) {
                    left = mid + 2;
                } else {
                    right = mid;
                }
            } else {
                if (nums[mid] == nums[mid - 1]) {
                    left = mid + 1;
                } else {
                    right = mid;
                }
            }
        }

        return nums[left];
    }
}
1752:--
class Solution {
    public boolean check(int[] nums) {
       return checki(nums);
    }
    public static boolean checki(int[] arr) {
	        int[] B = Arrays.copyOf(arr, arr.length); // Create a copy of the original array
	        Arrays.sort(arr); // Sort the array

	        for (int x = 0; x < arr.length; x++) {
	            boolean isRotation = true;

	            // Check if the sorted array matches any rotation of B
	            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
	                if (arr[i] != B[(i + x) % arr.length]) {
	                    isRotation = false;
	                    break;
	                }
	            }

	            if (isRotation) {
	                return true;
	            }
	        }

	        return false;
	    }
}

class Solution {
    public int removeDuplicates(int[] nums) {
      return expected(nums);
        }
        public static int expected(int[] arr) {
//	int i=1;
	int c=1;
    int j=1;
	for(int i=1;i<arr.length;i++) {
		if(arr[i]!=arr[i-1]) {
			c++;
            arr[j]=arr[i];
            j++;
		}
	}
	return c;
}
    }

class Solution {
    public int findMaxConsecutiveOnes(int[] nums) {
          int c = 0;
        int ans = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
            if (nums[i] == 1) {
                c++;
            } else {
                ans = Math.max(ans, c);
                c = 0;
            }
        }
        ans = Math.max(ans, c);
return ans;
    }
}

class Solution {
    public int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        return twosum1(nums,target);
    }
    public static int[] twosum1(int [] arr,int n) {
        int []a=new int[2];
        int k=0;
	for(int i=0;i<arr.length-1;i++) {
        for(int j=i+1;j<arr.length;j++){
		if((arr[i]+arr[j])==n) {
         a[k]=i;
         a[k+1]=j;
		}
        }
	}
    return a;
}
}

class Solution {
    public void sortColors(int[] nums) {
        Sort(nums,0,nums.length-1);
    }
    public static void Sort(int[] arr,int si,int ei) {
		if(si>=ei)
			return;
		int idx=Partition(arr,si,ei);
		Sort(arr,si,idx-1);
		Sort(arr,idx+1,ei);
	}
	public static int Partition(int[] arr,int si,int ei) {
        
		int idx=si;
		int item=arr[ei];
		for(int i=si;i<ei;i++) {
			if(arr[i]<=item) {
				swap(i,idx,arr);
				idx++;
			}
		}
		swap(idx,ei,arr);
		return idx;
	}
public static void swap(int a,int b,int[] arr1) {
	int temp=arr1[a];
	arr1[a]=arr1[b];
	arr1[b]=temp;
}
}

class Solution {
    public int majorityElement(int[] nums) {
        // Arrays.sort(nums);
        // int n = nums.length;
        // return nums[n/2];
        Arrays.sort(nums);
        if(nums.length==1)
        return nums[0];
for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++) {
	int c=0;
	int temp=nums[i];
	for(int j=i+1;j<nums.length;j++) {
		if(nums[j]==nums[i]) {
			c++;
			if(c==nums.length/2)
return nums[j];	
			}
	}
}
    return -1;
    }
}
